required_fixes: The paragraph of Decreto 780 art. 2.2.1.1.2.1 is paraphrased beyond its text: it covers salary or pension from two or more employers (or simultaneous employee and independent status), not 'salary and pension' as such. Reword to follow the official text.

Cite Resolución 1271 de 2023 (MinSalud) art. 1 for the '>1 up to 3 SMLMV 10% / >3 SMLMV 12%' bands and state that they apply from 2024; Ley 2294 art. 78 alone says 'entre 2 y 3' and 'previa reglamentación'.
Add the legal basis for the pension 0.00 sentence: Ley 100 de 1993 art. 17, as amended by Ley 797 de 2003 art. 4.
suggested_wording:
Employee health contribution rate: 4.00% of the contribution base (Ley 100 de 1993 art. 204, as amended by Ley 1122 de 2007 art. 10). The employer's 8.5% is NOT an employee deduction and must never appear here.

A working old-age pensioner (worker sub-type 01) still contributes to health: 4.00% on the salary (Ley 100 de 1993 art. 157; Decreto 780 de 2016 art. 2.2.1.1.2.1 - the base of a worker under a labour contract is the monthly salary; where the affiliate receives salary or pension from two or more employers, the contributions are made in proportion to the salary or pension received from each, paragraph of the same article). Only the pension contribution is 0.00 for sub-type 01 (NIE164): the obligation to contribute to pension ceases once the affiliate meets the requirements for the old-age pension (Ley 100 de 1993 art. 17, as amended by Ley 797 de 2003 art. 4).

For a pensioner paid by the employer the base is the mesada pensional (Decreto 780 de 2016 art. 2.2.1.1.2.1) and, from 2024, the rate follows the pension band: 4% for a mesada of 1 SMLMV, 10% above 1 and up to 3 SMLMV, 12% above 3 SMLMV (Ley 100 de 1993 art. 204 par. 5, with the inciso added by Ley 2294 de 2023 art. 78; Resolución 1271 de 2023 art. 1); Porcentaje is the band rate and Deduccion the amount on the mesada.

For an apprentice without contribution, Salud and FondoPension are still emitted (1-1) with Porcentaje 0.00 and Deduccion 0.00.
